source_title: 'Udta Teer' day 7: Ayushmann's film outperforms 'Pati Patni Aur Woh Do' by 15%
source_excerpt: 'Udta Teer', featuring Ayushmann Khurrana and Sara Ali Khan, has wrapped up its opening week with a steady box office performance, pushing its worldwide gross beyond Rs 46 cr. According to Sacnilk, the spy comedy earned Rs 2.60 cr net from its Indian theatrical run on Thursday, October 29. The collection was recorded across 5,744 screenings.Following the latest addition, the film's domestic net earnings have accumulated to Rs 31.25 cr, while its India gross stands at Rs 37.28 cr. Overseas markets contributed Rs 50 lakh on Thursday, taking the film's cumulative international gross to Rs 9 cr. This brings its total worldwide earnings to Rs 46.28 cr.The latest domestic earnings registered a marginal decline of 1.9% compared with Wednesday's collection of Rs 2.65 cr. The film recorded an average collection of approximately Rs 4,526 per show. Its overall occupancy across Hindi 2D screenings stood at 12.64%.'Udta Teer' earns 15% more than 'Pati Patni Aur Woh Do'At the same stage of their theatrical runs, 'Udta Teer' has performed better than Ayushmann Khurrana's previous release, 'Pati Patni Aur Woh Do'. The latter collected Rs 2 cr net in India on its seventh day from 4,940 shows. Its cumulative domestic net collection stood at Rs 29 cr, while the India gross reached Rs 34.43 cr.The overseas market contributed Rs 50 lakh on its seventh day, taking the cumulative international gross to Rs 5.80 cr. Its worldwide gross collection stood at Rs 40.23 cr. In comparison, 'Udta Teer' has earned approximately 15% more worldwide than 'Pati Patni Aur Woh Do' at the corresponding stage. The difference between their worldwide gross collections stands at Rs 6.05 cr.'Udta Teer' Day 7 box office collection and occupancyThe movie recorded its highest occupancy during night shows, which registered 17.92%. Evening screenings followed with 11.92%, while afternoon shows recorded 11.85%. Morning performances remained comparatively lower at 6.31%.The film registered 146,645 admissions on Thursday. Its cumulative footfalls have now reached 1,613,257. These figures provide an indication of the audience turnout during its opening week, even as weekday collections witnessed a gradual reduction.'Udta Teer' opening week box office performanceThe Ayushmann Khurrana and Sara Ali Khan starrer began its theatrical journey with Rs 4.10 cr on Friday. Saturday witnessed an improvement, with earnings rising to Rs 7.25 cr. The film recorded its biggest single-day collection on Sunday, bringing in Rs 8.20 cr.The collections subsequently declined when the working week began. Monday contributed Rs 3.20 cr, while Tuesday registered a slight improvement with Rs 3.25 cr.
